scope_summary: Integrate preserved motion/UI work with main ed2104d9; retain variable roster, v1/v2 saves and all47 approved static-art inputs. Review branch only until four character sheets final visual lock. No original asset deletions, no game-rule or save-schema change, no Human/device/release claim. P01 separates immutable starter provenance from earned ownership and validates combat ownership against reconstructed reward history, without a new save schema or reward rule. Subsequent P02/v3 and P03/v4 are explicitly authorized by their listed Decisions; earlier no-schema-change statements describe the earlier presentation/P01 scope only. P03 preserves v1/v2/v3 content identities and adds stats-v4 only for new runs. Card presets and disposable resolved-event choreography are presentation-only. Preserve domain/save/AI/approved-art bytes and final-art gate. First-five diversity applies only to new draws. Stats-v4 public AI signature introduction and authored timed responses repair actual-use gaps; old frozen rosters and legacy execution stay. Optional grading evidence does not choose final grades or rewards.
